backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (routing, navigation, home page, lessons page, etc.) to their source files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document providing one-line summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key contents.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining light and dark mode CSS custom properties (OKLCH color tokens) for the shadcn-ui design system.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app titled 'Reema's Italian Studio', mounting the app at the #root div and loading main.tsx as a module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root app component using TanStack Router with a shared layout (Navigation + Footer) and five client-side routes: Home, Lessons, Videos, About, and Contact.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Dark-themed footer with an Italian flag accent bar, brand logo, quick navigation links, and social media icons (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook) with a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/ItalianAccent.ts: Reusable horizontal tricolor divider component rendering Italian flag colors (green, white, red) as a thin decorative bar.
frontend/src/components/LessonCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a lesson icon, category badge, title, description, and a 'Start Lesson' button linking to a configurable route.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky responsive navigation bar with an Italian flag tricolor top accent, brand logo, active-highlighted desktop nav links, and a mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Reusable video card component rendering a lazy-loaded 16:9 YouTube iframe embed with a title below it.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind CSS layers, and defines CSS custom properties for an Italian-themed color palette with light and dark mode support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page displaying teacher bio, benefits of learning Italian, and a call-to-action section with icons and styled layout.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a validated contact form (name, email, message) and social media links for YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page featuring a hero section, featured lesson cards, and student testimonials targeting Indian learners of Italian.
frontend/src/pages/Lessons.tsx: Defines the Lessons page with three categorized sections (Beginner, Vocabulary, Grammar), each containing lesson data arrays and rendered via a reusable LessonSection component that displays LessonCards in a responsive grid.
frontend/src/pages/Videos.tsx: Defines the Videos page displaying a grid of 9 YouTube video lesson cards with a page header, subscribe button, and a call-to-action section linking to the YouTube channel.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom Italian flag colors, display/sans font families, border radii, box shadows, and CSS variable-based color tokens, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Tracks the project state for 'Reema's Italian Studio' educational website, recording schema version, architectural notes, existing implemented features, known issues, and image requirements for the multi-page React application.
